dcterms:description: The Xing dataset contains interactions on job postings for 770,000 users over an 80-day period. User behaviors include click, bookmark, reply, and delete. Sessions are split by a 30-minute idle threshold, and interactions of the same type within sessions are discarded to reduce noise.
dcterms:title: Xing Dataset

dcterms:description: The Reddit dataset contains tuples of user names, subreddits where users make comments, and timestamps for interactions. Sessions are split manually using a 60-minute time threshold.
dcterms:title: Reddit Dataset
